chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about those who are deformed in their creation.
He said: “They are those whose fathers come to their wives during menstruation.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمُشَوَّهِينَ: those who are deformed or physically disfigured

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about intercourse during menstruation and physical deformity?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning those described as physically deformed in their creation. He attributes this to fathers having intercourse with their wives during menstruation, reflecting a warning tied to menstruation-related rulings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.202 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about those who are deformed in their creation.
Imam (as) said: 'They are those whose fathers engaged in intercourse with their wives during menstruation.'
